title: Verify essential mobile flows and add a safe PWA shell
files: src/app/*; public/manifest.webmanifest; service-worker configuration; tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts; docs/accessibility.md
interface: Installable shell caches public assets only; responsive and keyboard behavior applies to implemented work/review/admin flows.
steps: Add manifest/install affordance and useful offline state without caching authenticated APIs, files, OAuth callbacks or private drafts.
Audit 320px/zoom, visible focus/contrast, modal focus, labels/errors, screen-reader updates and keyboard alternatives in actual essential flows.
Fix discovered barriers in shared components and targeted screens; capture real screenshots/check results with synthetic data. Do not redesign the app.
checks: Signing out/offline cannot expose previous user's finance/task payload or service-worker cache.
Keyboard-only user completes task, handoff and review; mobile controls remain 44px and usable at 200% zoom.
Automated axe plus manual evidence recorded; no blanket WCAG certification based only on an automated scan.

title: Prepare Cloudflare/Supabase release and deploy a synthetic preview
files: Cloudflare build/headers config; .env.example; docs/deployment.md; docs/integrations.md; deployment verification scripts
interface: Reproducible static build plus explicit environment matrix/redirects/secrets references, verified migration plan and rollback; preview and production remain isolated.
steps: Prepare Cloudflare Pages static build/routing/headers/CSP and Supabase environment/provider settings, migration order, capacity check, credential custody and rollback instructions.

Deploy synthetic preview only to an existing explicitly identified organization-controlled preview target when access is available. This prompt authorizes that named preview deployment; request missing target selection rather than guessing.
Verify external auth redirects, denied anonymous APIs, secret-free bundle and source/project ownership. Produce production candidate package, not automatic real-data rollout.
checks: Fresh clean build runs on preview; SPA deep links and correct OAuth return work or exact provider block is recorded.
Preview contains synthetic data only; client bundle has no elevated credentials and private APIs remain protected.
Production target and backup/migration/rollback prerequisites are documented without running destructive remote commands.

title: Run the core pilot release gate and prepare human UAT
files: tests/e2e/core-pilot.spec.ts; docs/uat/*; docs/build/release-gate.md; feature fixes as justified
interface: Reproducible synthetic core slice and a human-test checklist with separate observed/automated/human-pending results.
steps: Exercise school member/head/FIN/MCD/guest flows: deliverable -> synergy -> task/dependency -> handoff -> versioned reviews -> acceptance, including required denials.
Prepare role-specific UAT scripts for both MEAn and non-MEAn participants, first-task guidance, steward instructions, privacy gate and defect triage.
Fix supported P0/P1 implementation defects within this session budget. Human UAT needs actual user evidence; do not fabricate participants, feedback or approvals and do not send invitations/messages.
checks: Core happy path and negative access/revision/self-approval cases pass with release revision recorded.
Human results remain pending until observed; zero open P0/P1 is required for a green release gate.
Actual restore, relevant school authority/privacy decisions and named custodians are verified or explicitly listed as blockers.

title: Connect scoped Google Drive selection
interface: Separate Drive OAuth connection and Picker use drive.file or least necessary scope; server-only refresh-token storage, revoke/reconnect and selected-file metadata.
steps: Implement explicit Connect Drive consent separate from login, approved redirect/state checks and provider-owner custody. No all-drive crawling.
Add Picker-based selected files for authorized work, validating provider IDs, current record permission and selected file access.
Handle school admin denial, revoked scopes and testing-mode token expiry; retain working link/private upload fallback.
checks: Client receives no refresh token/client secret and cannot nominate arbitrary unselected Drive files for broad reads.
Different dashboard member cannot use connection to bypass their record/file access.
Real selected-file flow verified if school/provider setup exists; otherwise adapter code/local tests marked external-blocked, not fully integrated.

title: Export selected final evidence safely between app and Drive
interface: User-triggered rendition/export creates new immutable app asset/Drive copy with manifest and destination classification; source and approved snapshot stay distinct.
steps: Export explicitly selected Google-native final rendition into private app evidence, hashing bytes and binding caption/use in the submitted revision.
Implement authorized selected-file/data copy into approved Drive folder with current destination-permission check and audit. Separate FIN/PRISM destinations; no membership-wide sensitive mirroring.
Add resumable progress/error handling and duplicate-copy prevention; preserve originals until a verified archival disposition.
checks: Changed Drive/Canva source cannot rewrite approved app snapshot or retained decision hash.
Private FIN/PRISM file cannot be copied into broader folder without explicit authorized reclassification/policy; deny unsafe destination.
Retry does not create endless duplicate files; revoked destination access yields clear recoverable failure.

title: Implement one-way core-calendar publishing
interface: App remains authoritative; explicit core-safe app events map to one approved core calendar, with source version, remote IDs, tombstones and durable token lifecycle.
steps: Implement separately authorized connection and explicit app-to-Google publish/update/cancel jobs; document external-edit conflict policy.
Add idempotent mapping, retry/backoff, revoked-auth repair, last-sync/error view, and safe token storage. No private task/mentee/finance data in general calendar.
If reconciliation reads use incremental tokens, handle HTTP410 by rebuilding mapped remote cache without deleting canonical app events.
checks: Create/update/retry/cancel results in one correctly timed remote event, no resurrection after tombstone.
Expired/testing/revoked token shows stale state and fallback; never claims synced after failure.
Private event/export preferences cannot leak through shared calendar title/description/location.

title: Add opt-in Telegram alerts without reading group chats
interface: One-time account-link code binds started bot chat to authenticated member; webhook secret validation and minimal outbox adapter.
steps: Build opt-in link/unlink flow after member starts bot; hash short-lived binding code and prevent chat takeover/reuse.
Implement authenticated provider webhook handling and dispatch safe generic restricted alerts with deep links, quiet-hours/digest preferences and bounded retries.
Provide failure/relink status; no group-chat scraping, automatic personal-account messaging or unrequested announcements.
checks: Stolen/expired/reused linking code cannot attach another member; invalid webhook source rejected.
Revoked member or removed channel stops new deliveries and cannot open protected deep link.
Repeated dispatch deduplicates logically and carries no private financial/evaluation contents.

title: Add a verified email sender and optional non-Google guest login
interface: Approved sender with tested quota/domain and server-only credentials; optional guest OTP identity must still redeem exact invite and scope.
steps: Connect existing approved free/organization sender only; implement minimal digest/transactional adapter with rate caps, dedup, retry and delivery health. No assumed Supabase default SMTP production service.
If provider delivery is verified, add email OTP/magic-link guest entry with verified address, single-use exact invitation and safe return URL. Do not activate it on an untested sender.
Handle bounce/quota/revocation and identity-linking/account-takeover risks; leave in-app/Google/manual invite link fallback working.
checks: Wrong email/expired invite/OTP replay cannot gain guest access; unverified email cannot link to existing school member.
Sensitive email is generic with authenticated link and never contains receipt/feedback text.
Missing sender/DNS/quota blocks external verification and activation rather than returning fake sent messages.

title: Implement conflict-safe Logistics room booking
interface: confirm_booking enforces official evidence and database exclusion over room/buffered half-open range for confirmed/persisted active holds.
steps: Model rooms/accessibility/equipment and requests, expiring holds, confirmation and cancellation with Logistics authority.
Expire stale holds in confirmation transaction and serialize competing transitions; a worker is not sole protection against stuck holds.
Require external school reservation evidence or official not-required policy; create calendar source only for confirmed room.
checks: Two concurrent overlapping confirmations cannot both succeed; adjacent nonbuffered slots behave correctly.
Expired hold cannot block indefinitely if scheduler is down; setup/cleanup buffers count.
Request submission or a calendar event alone cannot masquerade as official room reservation.

title: Build room intake, Logistics confirmation and calendar views
interface: Room UI uses P56 commands, showing desired vs confirmed slot, evidence and conflict/alternative negotiation.
steps: Build accessible room/time/requirements request, Logistics availability/conflict view and alternative-slot acceptance.
Add official reference/evidence, confirmed/cancelled details and linked calendar entry. Initial recurring sessions are separate explicit instances.
Handle stale availability and concurrent-conflict response without false confirmation or losing requester's safe input.
checks: Mobile/keyboard requester can submit and distinguish pending from confirmed.
Change/cancel updates actual reservation/calendar without stale duplicates.
Unauthorized role cannot confirm, and private meeting details remain scoped despite room availability display.

title: Build SUS inventory reservation, checkout and return
interface: Item master, custodians and immutable quantity/condition movements; atomic reserve/issue/partial-return/cancel, FIN linkage for costs.
steps: Add stock/borrower/dates/condition/location schema and authorized request/custodian screens with simple ledger rather than overwritable available count.
Implement concurrent reservation, physical issue confirmation, returns, partial returns and loss/damage notes with evidence.
Distinguish consumables from returnable items; route purchase/replacement costs to FIN and queue departed-custodian reassignment.
checks: Simultaneous borrowers cannot reserve more than available and repeat return cannot inflate stock.
Partial return/lost item yields consistent balance/condition/audit rather than silent negative inventory.
Replacement expense cannot be approved by inventory role without FIN authority; unauthorized borrower details stay private.

title: Build opt-in goals and scoped mentor check-ins
interface: mentorships have approved effective dates; owned goals/sharing and author-attributed check-ins are separate from evaluations.
steps: Build goals, target/progress and sharing choice, assigned-mentor list, check-in schedule/actions and attributable notes.
Enforce relationship expiry/reassignment and withdrawal of sharing; mentor cannot edit mentee's goal wording or read evaluation cases.
Connect private check-in calendar only through permitted audience/explicit opt-in export; apply category retention and member export.
checks: Former mentor with live session loses access after relationship expiry/revoke.
Head/PM/PRISM roles have no automatic raw goal access unless explicit appropriate grant.
Private check-in title/notes do not leak through core calendar/search/reports.

title: Create restricted evaluation rounds, submissions and release rules
interface: feedback_rounds/submissions/revisions/reviewer notes and separate evaluation_releases; audited restricted RPC reads, no broad table SELECT.
steps: Implement round purpose/template/subject/reviewer/retention/release policy with explicit conflicts and reviewer assignments.
Keep author's submitted record immutable, append amendments, separate raw third-party feedback from released subject summary and apply holds/dispositions.
Require recorded custodian/basis/retention before real-data activation; use synthetic fixtures and explain anonymity limits.
checks: Subject, mentor, PM and ordinary admin cannot read raw third-party feedback by knowing IDs or querying joins.
Revoked/conflicted reviewer cannot submit/release; wrong-subject summary cannot be published.
Restricted reads/downloads/export audit without raw text, and retention respects hold and backup replay.

title: Build PRISM desk, released summaries and safe aggregates
interface: UI consumes restricted P60 APIs; author/assigned-reviewer/subject-release views distinct; aggregation suppresses groups below five and reconstructive filters.
steps: Build feedback submission, assigned PRISM queue, attributable reviewer notes, controlled summary review/release and subject-visible results.
Add explicit export control and minimum-group reporting; prevent differencing/drilldown that reconstructs identities.
Publish clear anonymity/rights/retention text, route formal complaints to approved school process, and verify no raw content enters global search or notifications.
checks: Subject sees only released summary; author edits produce a revision, not overwritten submitted evidence.
Groups under five and difference-of-filters reconstruction cannot expose individuals.
Real sensitive activation stays blocked without actual owner/policy/UAT; screenshots and test fixtures contain synthetic data only.

title: Implement verified term freeze, archive and successor handover
interface: freeze_term and run_archive create resumable scoped manifests, records/files dispositions and verification; new-term roles are explicitly regranted.
steps: Build closure checklists per unit/deliverable, unresolved obligation resolution/carry-forward, freeze, classified archive plan and legal holds.
Implement resumable records/config/file export with counts/hashes/errors and actual restore sample, plus successor acceptance/custody checklist.
Preserve raw FIN/PRISM boundaries; revoke outgoing scopes only through named transfer workflow. Rehearse synthetically now; do not freeze the live term or purge real data just to test.
checks: Missing file/failed hash/unfinished export cannot show turnover complete.
Frozen term rejects ordinary mutation while controlled correction/retention operations remain audited.
Successor gets explicitly granted records, not automatic raw evaluations; every record has archive/dispose/hold/carry disposition.

title: Audit the integrated build, release eligible scope and hand over
refs: Sections 3/6/11/12/14/15; all enabled feature acceptance criteria
files: docs/build/release-gate.md; docs/uat/*; docs/admin-guide.md; docs/deployment.md; docs/recovery.md; docs/turnover.md; targeted fixes/tests
interface: Final report names exact release revision, enabled/disabled/externally-blocked modules, security/UAT/recovery evidence, verified production target and successor operations.
steps: Read current state/contracts and targeted high-risk code, not all files indiscriminately. Audit transitive access, same-term/guest revocation, stale approvals, config privilege changes, outbox, recovery and private exports; add focused regression tests for genuine findings.

Reconcile all required F01–F26 coverage against implemented or deliberately disabled optional scope. Verify actual mixed-background human UAT, authority/privacy decisions and restore evidence; do not pretend simulated review is independent security certification.

This prompt includes deployment of the tested eligible build to the already identified organization-owned production targets if gates passed, account access exists and migrations/backups/rollback are verified. Ask only for genuinely missing target/input. Otherwise deliver a complete candidate with precise blockers. Prepare head/admin/custodian instructions and event/manual-fallback rehearsal; do not send rollout messages or invoke live end-term closure.
checks: Zero open critical/high release blockers and required checks pass on the actual release revision; no skipped optional module is misreported as complete.
Production smoke tests, privacy boundaries and OAuth verified if released; otherwise final status explicitly remains candidate/blocked.
Second-custodian/successor tasks and account custody are recorded; handover requires real acknowledgment, not a generated claim.
